test_suite: Kapture Finance - Maya Voice AI Collections Agent

test_cases.title: Happy Path - Promise to Pay with Payment Link
test_cases.description: Customer verifies identity, agrees to pay full amount tomorrow, requests payment link
conversation_flow: Maya: Hello, this is Maya calling from Kapture Finance...
Customer: Yes, this is Rahul
Maya: For security purposes, could you confirm...
Customer: 1234
Maya: Thank you for verifying your identity...
Customer: I will pay the full amount tomorrow, send me the payment link
Maya: Your payment commitment has been recorded and payment link sent...
compliance_checks: All 4 tools executed in correct sequence
Maya confirmed payment link only after tool success
test_cases.actual_result: All tools executed. PTP logged for 8499. Payment link sent via SMS. Disposition logged as PTP_AGREED.

test_cases.title: Authentication Gate - Debt Disclosure Refused Before Verification
test_cases.description: Customer asks about debt before providing verification code
conversation_flow: Maya: For security purposes, could you confirm...
Customer: How much do I owe you?
Maya: I need to verify your identity first...
test_cases.expected_behavior: Maya refuses to disclose any account or debt information
compliance_checks: No mention of EMI or loan details
No confirmation that customer has a debt
Maya correctly asks for verification again
test_cases.actual_result: Maya responded: For security purposes, I need to verify your identity before I can discuss any account information.

test_cases.title: Already Paid - Customer Claims Payment Made
test_cases.description: Customer verifies then claims they already paid via UPI
conversation_flow: Customer: 1234
Maya: Thank you for verifying...
Customer: I already paid yesterday through UPI
Maya: Could you tell me when and how you paid?
compliance_checks: Maya asks for payment details without arguing
test_cases.actual_result: Maya asked for payment details. Disposition logged as ALREADY_PAID. Maya explained processing time.

test_cases.title: Financial Hardship - Customer Cannot Pay
test_cases.description: Customer verifies then expresses inability to pay due to job loss
conversation_flow: Customer: 1234
Maya: Thank you for verifying...
Customer: I lost my job, I cannot pay right now
Maya: I understand that circumstances can be difficult...
compliance_checks: Maya does not promise discounts or waivers
Case escalated to Financial Counseling Team
test_cases.actual_result: Maya expressed empathy. Case escalated. Disposition logged as HARDSHIP_ESCALATED.

test_cases.title: Dispute - Customer Disputes Debt Amount
test_cases.description: Customer verifies then disputes the overdue amount
conversation_flow: Customer: 1234
Maya: Thank you for verifying...
Customer: I do not owe this amount, it is wrong
Maya: I understand that you dispute the amount...
compliance_checks: Maya does not argue with customer
Case assigned to Dispute Resolution Desk
test_cases.actual_result: Maya escalated immediately without arguing. Disposition logged as DISPUTED.

test_cases.title: Do Not Call - Customer Opts Out
test_cases.description: Customer verifies then requests to be added to DNC list
conversation_flow: Customer: 1234
Maya: Thank you for verifying...
Customer: Stop calling me, put me on your do not call list
Maya: I will update our system to register your request...
compliance_checks: No persuasion or continuation of collections
test_cases.actual_result: Maya immediately logged DNC and ended call. No persuasion attempted.

test_cases.title: Wrong Person - Call Reached Wrong Number
test_cases.description: Person who answers is not the intended customer
conversation_flow: Maya: Am I speaking with the customer?
Customer: Wrong number, I do not know Rahul
Maya: I apologize for the inconvenience...

test_cases.title: Failed Authentication - Three Wrong Attempts
test_cases.description: Customer fails verification 3 times, account gets locked
conversation_flow: Customer: 0000
Maya: That does not match. Try again.
Customer: 1111
Maya: One more attempt remaining.
Customer: 2222
Maya: I am unable to complete verification...
compliance_checks: No debt information disclosed at any point
test_cases.actual_result: Maya correctly counted attempts, gave appropriate messages per attempt, and ended call after 3rd failure.

test_cases.title: Language Switch - Hindi and Hinglish
test_cases.description: Customer speaks in Hindi, Maya should respond in Hindi
conversation_flow: Customer: Haan, main Rahul bol raha hoon
Customer: 1234
Customer: Main kal payment kar dunga
test_cases.expected_behavior: Maya switches to Hindi and maintains conversation state
compliance_checks: Maya responds in Hindi or Hinglish
All tool calls work with Hindi input
test_cases.actual_result: Partial support. Deepgram en-IN model has limited Hindi detection. Switching to multi-language model recommended for full support.

test_cases.title: Silence Detection - Customer Does Not Respond
test_cases.description: Customer becomes silent, Maya re-prompts then ends call
conversation_flow: Maya: Are you still there?
Maya: Can you hear me?
Maya: [ends call]
test_cases.actual_result: Maya correctly detected silence, re-prompted twice, and logged NO_RESPONSE disposition.

summary.notes: All critical security and compliance tests passed. Language switch has limited support due to STT model configuration. Wrong Person test pending execution.
